section.sectionSummaryBrief: Through the future revelation of the Yechidah of all of Hishtalshelus, there will be an incomparable elevation in wisdom, teshuvah, and good deeds.
section.t: And to add,
that through the revelation of the Yechidah of all of Hishtalshelus that will be in the future to come,
there will be an additional elevation in all three matters
(wisdom,
teshuvah and good deeds),
even to an elevation that is beyond comparison.
For regarding Torah
(wisdom)
our sages said,
that the Torah of now is vanity compared to the Torah of Moshiach,
and regarding teshuvah it is known
that Moshiach comes to bring the righteous to teshuvah,
for the teshuvah of the righteous is more elevated than simple teshuvah,
and regarding good deeds it is known
that at the coming of Moshiach the fulfillment of the mitzvos will be in ultimate perfection.
And it can be said,
that in the perfection of good deeds and lights that will be then, is also included that all matters of the world of Asiyah will shine,
even to the extent that also night will shine like day,
in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our righteousness,
and in a manner that immediately they are redeemed.
